Kandahar pomegranates are famous for their deep red seeds and sweet-sour taste. In season we buy them straight from the orchards and send them quickly by air or road so they arrive fresh.

Each consignment is sorted and packed in Kandahar, with the phytosanitary and export papers arranged.

items.heading: Afghan dried figs
items.summary: Sun-dried figs from Kandahar, sorted, graded and packed for export.
items.description:
Our dried figs come from orchards in Kandahar and the surrounding provinces, where the dry summers let the fruit dry naturally in the sun. They are soft, sweet and naturally golden to light brown.

Every lot is cleaned, sorted by size and checked for moisture and colour in Kandahar before it is packed. We send photos or samples of the lot before it ships, and arrange the export papers and freight.
